title: Hoffmann Green Cement chooses Isometric to certify its clinker-free cement products
summary: Hoffmann Green Cement chooses Isometric to certify its clinker-free cement products
body_markdown:
**France:** Hoffmann Green Cement Technologies has selected environmental certifier Isometric to certify its clinker-free cements products under the Low Carbon Cement Protocol, which enables the issuance of Environmental Attribute Certificates (EAC). It hopes to use a book and claim mechanism to benefit from the commercialisation of the environmental benefits of low-carbon cements independently of their physical delivery, particularly in markets in the US, Europe and Asia. It anticipates that the venture could generate, over time, several million Euros in additional revenue for the company.


Isometric certifies carbon removals, emissions reductions and environmental attributes under its scientific protocols with independent third-party verification. Its Low Carbon Cement Protocol enables the issuance of certificates for the environmental attributes of low-carbon cement production, provided projects meet its eligibility and certification requirements. This mechanism, known as book and claim, allows the environmental attributes of cement to be separated from its physical delivery. Cement manufacturers can then monetise environmental certificates by selling them to companies in other geographical markets, without having to export the corresponding volumes of cement. Hoffmann Green Cement is the first cement producer to partner with Isometric under this protocol.


Julien Blanchard and David Hoffman, Co-founders of Hoffmann Green Cement Technologies, said, " By becoming the first cement manufacturer to partner with Isometric under this protocol, we are opening up a particularly promising commercial opportunity: monetising the environmental performance of our cements through international buyers, without having to physically export our products.”


Lukas May, Chief Commercial Officer of Isometric, added, "EACs unlock global demand for low-carbon production, creating new sources of revenue for the innovative technologies that will decarbonise heavy industry. Our Low Carbon Cement Protocol ensures every certificate is backed by public evidence, giving buyers complete confidence in the EACs generated by manufacturers like Hoffmann Green."
